notes: Measured 11 Sep 2026 against out/raw/section_3_MAIN_OS.bin under route A (tools/emu/emu_rtos.py), evidence in tools/panel/KEYMAP.md. keys: [row, bit] of the panel-UART matrix report `<row> <column-bitmask>` (rows are decimal here: 32=0x20 trig 1-8, 33=0x21 trig 9-16, 34=0x22 T1-T8, 35=0x23, 36=0x24, 37=0x25, 38=0x26); set bit = held. knobs: the row byte of an encoder report `<row> <signed detent delta>` (48=0x30 .. 54=0x36); A-F are the six under the screen in the OT order (MIXER: A MAIN, B DIR AB, C GAIN AB, D CUE, E DIR CD, F GAIN CD; PLAYBACK page: A..F = the six parameter slots in order), LEVEL is the track level / MIX in the MIXER. leds: [row, bit] of the LED bitmap message (`0x20+row <mask>` for rows 0-15, `0xa0+(row-16)` beyond) -- i.e. panel_link.PanelLink.led_rows[row] bit `bit`, flattened by led_bits() to row*8+bit; the LED id for the `0x3n <id>` brightness messages is row*8+bit. NOT the `bits` string of panel_server's /leds: _parse_leds fills that from 0x10 <off> <8 bytes> frames, which are LCD page-0 blocks (measured 11 Sep 2026 on an own server: at boot bits[5] bit 0 and bits[8] bit 2 are 0 while LED rows 5=a9 / 8=04 have t1 and PLAYBACK lit; after REC bits[10] bit 4 stays 0 and bytes 4-63 change with the redraw; only ids 0x48 goes 6->15). Until /leds carries link.led_rows and panel.html's ledOn indexes it, these entries light nothing on the page. Trig and track LEDs are two-colour pairs: the listed even bit is the primary colour (MIXER unmuted audio trig, current bank/pattern, grid-rec trig, the SELECTED track); bit+1 is the second colour (MIDI trigs in the MIXER, the UNSELECTED tracks). Page LEDs likewise: bit+1 lights in MIDI mode. led_stop is lit while stopped, led_play while playing, both when paused (PLAY while playing). led_rec toggles with grid recording (REC key) and the brightness of id 72 (row 9 bit 0, dim 6 at boot) goes to 15 with it. led_tempo (row 4 bit 6) is INFERRED: it turns on with the first PLAY and stays on; no blinking was seen on the wire. Not found: led_func (holding FUNC changes no LED), led_card (a card mount sends no LED traffic), a REC SRC3 key, and the row 7 (0xff, brightness 0) and row 16 (0x0f) LEDs lit at boot. recab/reccd/scale are INFERRED from their FUNC layer (RECORDING 1 SETUP 1 / SETUP 2 / PATTERN SCALE window) and, for recab/reccd, from swallowing a TRACK press while held; alone they show nothing here. knob_push: the encoders' PUSH switches are key-matrix row 0x27 (39), bit = the encoder (A-F 0-5, LEVEL 6): with a TRIG key held in GRID RECORDING a push toggles that step's lock on the parameter the encoder edits (removes it; sets one at the current value if none), with a SCENE key held it removes the scene lock -- measured 13 Sep 2026 on the port (KEYMAP.md, the last section; c/d by the order), GET /knob/press?row=0x30..0x36 sends it. Rows 0x28-0x2f are not keys (an 0x27.x tap alone only nudges a 4-block redraw of the tempo readout). yes/no: YES stores the clock on the SET DATE/TIME dialog, enters the highlighted PROJECT-menu entry (MENU_FOCUS 0x400cbda8 moves, no redraw here) and closes the TEMPO window; NO closes one window level. On the BARE main screen YES draws the ARM ALL popup and NO the DISARM ALL popup (28 / 35 LCD blocks, 0x46c803d4 / 0x46c7fe22 := ffff); FUNC held does not change that (FUNC+YES / FUNC+NO are not a layer). Under the emulator those popups never time out (10 s idle) and only a full redraw (MIXER open+close) clears them, so one NO too many leaves DISARM ALL on the panel.
